structured_output.analysis:
The budget is 403/128 = 3.1484 bits per weight. The best recipe, iso_3.15 (E514ab09c524e), already uses 3.14795 bits, so there are almost no spare bits. The loss is concentrated in MLP projections that sit at int3 or rht_gptq_int2. For these layers, one more bit is measured to cut single-layer KL by about 0.0035 to 0.0045: 14.down rht2 0.00633 → rht3 0.00181; 27.up gptq3 0.00572 → gptq4 0.00217; 27.gate rht3 0.00499 → rht4 0.00153; 3.up 0.00642 → gptq4 0.00238; 2.up 0.00642 → gptq4 0.00237; 1.up 0.00611 → rht4 0.00227.

Upgrades have to be paid for. None of the retrieved records shows a cheap downgrade, so the only realistic funding is an option change: a coarser group_size of 256 lowers the scale overhead on every GPTQ-family layer. Changing act_order and damp costs no bits, so those can be tested on their own.

Three grids:
1. act_order only.
2. act_order plus a higher damp.
3. group_size=256 with act_order, spending the freed bits on about 8 upgrades of the layers listed above.

proposals.name: iso_actorder
proposals.rationale: Uses the same bits as iso_3.15, measured at KL 0.43614 (E514ab09c524e). This turns on act_order=true for all GPTQ-family methods, which hold most of the layers. GPTQ-quantized layers dominate the loss, for example 27.up gptq_int3 0.00572 (Ef04d8aa7bded) and 14.down rht_gptq_int2 0.00633 (E4c3f9b73e065).

proposals.name: iso_actorder_damp05
proposals.rationale: Uses the same bits as iso_3.15 (KL 0.43614, E514ab09c524e). This sets act_order=true with damp=0.05 instead of the default damp=0.01. Activation kurtosis is high in the layers where loss concentrates: 1090.09 at block 27 (E24beed188b6a) and 241.283 at 3.up (Eb1b68d163774). Stronger damping may stabilise the Hessian there.

proposals.name: g256_upgrade8
proposals.rationale: Setting weight.group_size=256 halves the per-group scale overhead on the GPTQ-family layers. The freed bits pay for 1-bit upgrades of 8 MLP layers, each 3145728 params, where the measured single-layer KL gain is large. 14.down: rht2 0.00633 (E4c3f9b73e065) → rht3 0.00181 (E90bd4b2f3645). 27.up: gptq3 0.00572 (Ef04d8aa7bded) → gptq4 0.00217 (Efea8c18d2abc). 27.gate: rht3 0.00499 (Efa0bb391da67) → rht4 0.00153 (Ef428ac081334). 3.up: 0.00642 (E6f4f7ea296d5) → gptq4 0.00238 (Ef4ee8cb4969e). 2.up: 0.00642 (E9baa10763ebe) → gptq4 0.00237 (Ef3d9c7b4502c). 1.up: 0.00611 (E0564bc6ad1eb) → rht4 0.00227 (E779bc065b72e). 18.gate and 11.gate are at rht2 with excess KL of 0.00497 (Eb1dd74cd6447) and 0.00443 (E9c454f30c659). act_order=true is also set.
